intelligent-chaos-engineering.title: Intelligent Chaos Engineering on AKS
intelligent-chaos-engineering.short: Chaos engineering on Azure Kubernetes Service, orchestrated by an LLM through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
intelligent-chaos-engineering.description: An intelligent chaos engineering solution integrating Kubernetes, Chaos Mesh, an LLM and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. It runs controlled failure experiments on Azure Kubernetes Service and observes the system's behaviour with Prometheus and Azure Monitor.
features: Monitoring using Prometheus and Azure Monitor
Intelligent scenario orchestration using LLM and MCP

openstack-cloud-infrastructure.title: OpenStack Cloud Infrastructure
openstack-cloud-infrastructure.short: A cloud infrastructure on OpenStack, provisioned with Terraform, configured with Ansible and monitored with Prometheus and Grafana.
openstack-cloud-infrastructure.description: Designed and automated a cloud infrastructure using OpenStack, Terraform and Ansible, including infrastructure provisioning, configuration automation, cloud resource management, metrics collection and monitoring dashboards.

edehn.title: EDEHN Website
edehn.short: The website of EDEHN (Équipe d'Économie Le Havre Normandie), deployed on a VPS.
edehn.description: The website of EDEHN — Équipe d'Économie Le Havre Normandie, an economics research team — deployed and hosted on a VPS (Virtual Private Server).
edehn.deployment: Deployed on a Linux VPS: Angular build served by Nginx, which also reverse-proxies the Spring Boot API running as a systemd service.

taxi-cross.title: Taxi Cross — Taxi Booking Platform
taxi-cross.short: A two-sided taxi booking platform: two Ionic mobile apps (clients and drivers), a Laravel REST API, real-time WebSockets and an admin website.
taxi-cross.description: Taxi Cross is a two-sided platform that makes it easier for clients to get a taxi and for drivers to find passengers quickly. It was built as the final-year project of my Bachelor's degree in Big Data & Data Analysis (ISIMS, University of Sfax) during an internship at Web Vue, a Sfax-based software agency. It includes a client mobile app, a driver mobile app and an administration website, all backed by a Laravel REST API and a Soketi WebSocket server for real-time updates.
features: Driver app: accept or cancel ride requests, view client positions on a map, follow the route and call the client
Client app: choose a destination, book a simple (+2 DT) or urgent (+3 DT) ride, 3-minute search countdown
Sign-up with SMS one-time password (OTP) verification
Real-time ride requests and updates through WebSockets (Soketi)
Interactive map with Leaflet and OpenStreetMap
Driver balance, top-up history and referral program (balance credited for each 10 referred users)
Ride history and complaints for clients and drivers
Admin website: manage drivers, clients, rides, complaints and balance top-ups, with a statistics dashboard

workflow.title: Broadcast
workflow.text: Request pushed to drivers via WebSockets

workflow.title: Accept
workflow.text: Driver accepts, calls client, follows route

taxi-cross.role: Final-year project of my Bachelor's in Big Data (ISIMS Sfax), built in a two-person team with Yosri Njeh during an internship at Web Vue (Feb–May 2023), following Scrum: design (UML), mobile apps, REST API and admin website.

ija-nahkiw.title: IjaNahkiw — Mental Health Platform
ija-nahkiw.short: A Symfony platform connecting patients with therapists: consultations, medical records, activities, forum and chatbot.
ija-nahkiw.description: IjaNahkiw ("come, let's talk") is a mental-health and wellbeing web platform built with Symfony as a team project at ESPRIT. Patients can book consultations with therapists, follow wellbeing programmes and activities, take questionnaires and talk to a chatbot, while therapists and administrators manage everything from a back-office dashboard.
features: Therapist consultations with calendar, search and sorting
Community forum: publications, comments and likes
Admin dashboard with statistics and charts
Sign-up with email verification, password reset and reCAPTCHA
ija-nahkiw.role: Team project (Projet Intégré) at ESPRIT, built with five other students.

tp-foyer.title: ESPRIT University Housing Management
tp-foyer.short: A Spring Boot REST API built at ESPRIT to manage universities, residences, rooms, students and reservations.
tp-foyer.description: Developed at ESPRIT, a layered Spring Boot REST API (controllers, services, repositories) for managing university student residences: universities, residences (foyers), blocks, rooms, students and room reservations, persisted in MySQL with Spring Data JPA.
features: REST endpoints for universities, residences, blocks and rooms
Room types and JPA entity relationships
tp-foyer.role: Academic project at ESPRIT (School of Engineering): design and development of the back-end API.

housing-soa.title: Housing & Appointments Web Services
housing-soa.short: JAX-RS RESTful services for housing listings and visit appointments.
housing-soa.description: A service-oriented Java application exposing RESTful web services with JAX-RS to manage housing listings (logements) and visit appointments (rendez-vous), with separate resource and business layers.
features: CRUD REST resources for housing listings

airport-management.title: Airport Management
airport-management.short: A C# .NET application modelling flights, planes, passengers and staff.
airport-management.description: A C# .NET solution split into an application core (domain, interfaces, services) and a console UI. It models flights, planes, passengers, travellers and staff, and queries flight data with LINQ and extension methods.
features: Domain model: flights, planes, passengers, staff
